I wrote quiz 0002 to `quizzes/0002.json` and its key to `keys/0002.json`. The quiz is on O4, who owns the control flow in workflows versus agents and when a fixed workflow is the better choice.

It has three multiple-choice and three short-answer items, alternating, all set in the makerspace assistant. O4 hasn't been taught yet and there's no lesson for it, so the items check the objective at the level its wording states. I didn't run a JSON check on the files, because the shell blocked that command.

I left misconception ids out of the key. The workspace has none yet for workflows versus agents, and I didn't want to invent ones. The rationales describe the typical wrong answers instead.

You can take it whenever you're ready.
